hypothesis: H-STRUCT-PRIOR (null-control lane): a sparse, label-free placement of 10,000 dot centres along six NNE-trending corridors (line y = tan(60 deg) * x + b, b in 4.48e6..4.50e6 m, perpendicular jitter sigma = 400 m) is a 'structural-corridor' guess. It uses no competition label or raster.
mechanism: Each dot is a radius-2-pixel disk (value 1.0) written to a float32 grid; all other cells are 0. No feature, label or catalogue layer is read. Seed 0x5EED. scripts/generate_unique_submission.py regenerates the array exactly (verified).
mimic: Any linear NNE-trending feature (roads, pipelines, drainage, the Walker Lane fabric itself) would be scored the same way; the placement cannot tell a fault from a road because it never looked at data.
